title: Ordinary Tuesday (baseline)
story: Fifteen vehicles arrive between 06:40 and 15:05 while three cars parked overnight leave during the day.

title: Code red at the emergency department
story: Mass-casualty mode closes the visitor and family zones to visitors (e11, e12, e15). Sadia can only use drop-off, so Ghazala is sent to the second drop-off bay.

title: Staff level full
story: Bays st3 and st4 are closed for repairs and st1, st2 hold the night shift until 15:00, so Dr Areeba overflows to the roof (e14).

title: Visitor level closed, dry weather
story: All visitor and family bays are out of service. Sadia's cheapest remaining bay is the roof (220 m with the 60 m roof penalty).

title: Visitor level closed and raining
story: Rain adds 300 m to the roof (k8), so the covered drop-off bay is now cheaper for Sadia even though her stay breaks the 15 minute limit.

title: Saad's EV is charged
story: At 90% battery s2 no longer fires; a charger would cost +40 m (k4), so the on-call bay (130 m) beats the charger (190 m).

title: Saad off call with a charged EV
story: Without on_call(saad) the on-call zone is closed to him; with a full battery the staff zone wins and Dr Areeba takes the next staff bay.

title: Waqar's ban is lifted
story: With no security_ban the NAF condition in a3 succeeds, so Waqar is cleared and parks in the visitor zone during visiting hours.

title: Yasir's plate re-read at 93%
story: He is identified (s1), but 15:05 is between visiting windows, so drop-off is his only entitlement and his 45 minute stay is flagged.

title: Bushra's badge is renewed
story: With the expiry moved to Oct 2027 s4 holds, a1 clears her and she takes a staff bay near admin.

title: Accessible bays closed: Noor's van is too tall
story: Noor's 230 cm wheelchair van cannot use the 210 cm ramp (f1), so the patient zone on L1 is out of reach. Only ground-floor drop-off remains, which pushes Kashif and Ghazala to dr2.

title: Delivery van misses its slot
story: Junaid arrives at 10:00; his slot ended at 09:30, so t4 fails, a4 does not clear him and the gate denies entry.

title: Tahir arrives on time
story: At 10:50 he is inside his appointment window (t2), so the patient zone opens to him; pt1 is still Imtiaz's, so he gets pt2.

title: Kashif visits in the evening
story: At 17:10 he is inside the evening visiting window (t3), so he gets a visitor bay instead of drop-off.

title: Dr Areeba arrives two hours early
story: At 05:30 she is more than 30 minutes before her shift, so t1 fails: no staff or roof entitlement, only drop-off, where she blocks dr1 for the day.

title: Unknown car blocks an ambulance bay
story: An unregistered car has been in amb1 since 05:00. The ambulance takes amb2; w3 and w4 raise a blocked-bay alert and a tow request.

title: Both ambulance bays blocked
story: With amb1 and amb2 both blocked, the ambulance (priority 0) falls back to the drop-off bay closest to the emergency entrance.

title: Two ambulances at 09:00
story: A second ambulance arrives in the same minute. Both are priority 0, so arrival order decides and each gets an ambulance bay.

title: Drop-off congestion: Kashif waits
story: dr2 is closed and a taxi holds dr1 until 10:30. Kashif can only use drop-off, so he waits 15 minutes and is placed when the taxi leaves.

title: Inconsistent data: car with two classes
story: The registry lists Sadia's car as both a car and an SUV. IC6 rejects the record and the DL reasoner reports the clash.

title: Inconsistent data: doctor recorded as a visitor
story: Dr Saad also appears in the visitor list. IC13 flags a person holding a staff role and a visitor role at once.

title: Inconsistent data: badge expires before issue
story: A typing error sets Hamid's badge to expire in 2024 although it was issued in 2025. IC9 catches it.
